# GEEKFUN

> SqlKit and DocKit are open-source desktop clients from GEEKFUN. Use SqlKit with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, and other SQL databases. DocKit is for NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and EasySearch. Data Studio Agent lets coding assistants use database connections from either app through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Products, downloads, and plans

- [SqlKit desktop SQL client](https://www.geekfun.club/products/sqlkit/)
- [DocKit desktop NoSQL client](https://www.geekfun.club/products/dockit/)
- [Data Studio Agent MCP server](https://www.geekfun.club/products/data-studio-agent/)
- [Downloads for macOS, Windows, and Linux](https://www.geekfun.club/download)
- [Community and Ultimate plans](https://www.geekfun.club/pricing)
